0022600004.text: Both the Timberwolves and the Miami Heat open their 2026-27 seasons when Minnesota visits Miami, and the Timberwolves won both of their 2025-26 meetings, most recently a 122-94 win in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026. Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, while Rudy Gobert, Bones Hyland, Enrique Freeman, Rocco Zikarsky and Trey Lyles are listed as day-to-day, and Miami is without Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bam Adebayo, Dru Smith and Pelle Larsson, who are also day-to-day. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Timberwolves a 50% chance of winning.
